text: 2026 BMW M4 Competition — Coupe, RWD, Gas. Asking price: $89,900. Mileage: 28 mi. Availability: available. Exterior color: Brooklyn Grey Metallic. Condition: New. VIN: WBS43AY09SCT12345. Stock #: M4D-2026-017. MSRP: $92,595. Exterior color: Brooklyn Grey Metallic. Interior: Black Merino Leather. Seats 4 across 2 doors. Engine: 3.0L M TwinPower Turbo inline-6 making 503 hp and 479 lb-ft @ 2,750-5,500 rpm. Transmission: 8-speed M Steptronic automatic. 0-60 mph in 3.8 seconds; top speed 155 mph. Fuel: Premium unleaded; 16 city / 23 highway / 19 combined mpg; 15.6-gallon tank. Warranty: 4-year / 50,000-mile new-vehicle limited warranty, 3-year / 36,000-mile complimentary scheduled maintenance, and 12-year unlimited-mile rust perforation coverage. Packages: Carbon Fiber Roof, M Carbon Bucket Seats, Executive Package, M Driver's Package, Driving Assistance Professional Package. Options: Harman Kardon Surround Sound, Heated steering wheel, Head-up display, Adaptive M suspension, M Sport differential, Carbon fiber interior trim, Laserlight headlights, Wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto, Parking Assistant Plus with surround-view cameras. Features: M TwinPower Turbo 3.0L inline-6 (503 hp), 8-speed M Steptronic transmission, Rear-wheel drive with M Sport differential, Adaptive M suspension, M Carbon bucket seats, Carbon-fiber roof, Carbon-fiber interior and exterior trim, Black Merino leather interior, Head-up display, Harman Kardon surround sound, Laserlight headlights, Driving Assistance Professional, Parking Assistant Plus with surround-view cameras, Wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto. This 2026 BMW M4 Competition is a rear-wheel-drive performance coupe powered by a 3.0-liter M TwinPower Turbo inline-six producing 503 horsepower and 479 lb-ft of torque, paired with an 8-speed M Steptronic automatic. It sprints from 0 to 60 mph in 3.8 seconds and is electronically limited to 155 mph (180 mph with the M Driver's Package). Finished in Brooklyn Grey Metallic over a Black Merino leather interior, it features M Carbon bucket seats, a carbon-fiber roof, carbon-fiber interior and exterior accents, the Executive Package, Driving Assistance Professional, Harman Kardon surround sound, a head-up display, and Laserlight headlights. As a new demonstrator unit it shows just 28 delivery miles and is backed by BMW's 4-year/50,000-mile new-vehicle warranty with complimentary scheduled maintenance. EPA-estimated fuel economy is 16 city / 23 highway / 19 combined mpg.
